task: Owner decision B: open the RAM under the BASIC ROM and make it usable by the build. Plumbing only; no content is moved into the window.

window.measured_extent: $A000-$BC1F = 7,200 B (BASIC disabled at coldstart, RAMTOP $C0, OS screen $BC20-$BFFF)
window.guard: BASIC_WINDOW_GUARD $BC1A-$BC1F, 6 B, reserved with no segment (same shape as the $9FFA Director guard)
window.availability: unconditional: disable_basic_rom forces PORTB bit 1 and writes BASICF at boot_stage2_atr_entry and boot_stage2_xex_entry

guard_proof.assert: .assert __BASIC_WINDOW_RAM_LAST__ <= __BASIC_WINDOW_GUARD_START__, lderror, "BASIC_WINDOW reaches the window guard at $BC1A"
guard_proof.filler: .res 7179, $00 appended to the BASIC_WINDOW segment (16 B probe + 7,179 B = 1 byte past $BC19)
ld65_output: /project/build/encounter-director.cfg:26: Warning: Segment ‘BASIC_WINDOW’ overflows memory area ‘BASIC_WINDOW_RAM’ by 1 byte
encounter-director-abi.s:358: Error: Assertion failed: BASIC_WINDOW reaches the window guard at $BC1A
guard_proof.result: ld65 exits 1 at buildHybridDirectorModule, long before any XEX or ATR is written. Filler removed afterwards.

host.before: finalDestination < $A000 && end <= $A000 -- "chunk destination enters the forbidden BASIC-ROM window"
host.after: finalDestination < $BC20 && end <= $BC20 -- "chunk destination enters the OS screen above $BC1F"

guest.before: end high >= $A1 fails; end high == $A0 fails unless end low == 0; destination page >= $A0 fails
guest.after: end high >= $BD fails; end high == $BC fails unless end low <= $20; destination page >= $BD fails

runtime_proof.method: A ninth DFMC record carrying an inert 16-byte pattern landed at $A000; the boot-smoke observer reads $A000-$A00F and PORTB in every snapshot.
runtime_proof.result: 8/8 byte-exact, PORTB bit 1 set in every snapshot. The two BASIC-enabled XEX sessions prove both that the ROM is unmapped and that the INITAD record is honoured by the binary loader.

probe_removed.reason: Its own DFMC record costs one ATR transport sector (183 -> 184). MEASURED: ATR menu 554 -> 556 (band +50, harmless) but the -nobasic ATR loader milestone moves 297 -> 299 and the loader raster is then not complete at the boot smoke's FIXED frame-300 observation, which has only 3 frames of margin and was never re-based when owner decision 22 re-based the menu deadline. That is a gate decision for the owner, and this task is plumbing only.
probe_removed.what_stays: The boot smoke keeps a standing PORTB-bit-1 assertion at frames 3050 and 3300 on all eight sessions, and reads the window back automatically as soon as BASIC_WINDOW carries content again (scripts/runtime-wall-trace.mjs).
probe_removed.cost_of_the_first_real_window_record: 1 ATR transport sector, ~2 ATR menu frames, and the frame-300 loader checkpoint.

gates.build: npm run build:candidate PASS; transport 183 sectors, XEX 23,862 B, boot 104 sectors -- byte-for-byte the same shape as HEAD
gates.label_diff: Every runtime address that moved is inside BOOT_STAGE2 $21C1-$26C2, the transient boot overlay that unpack_resident_runtime overwrites before gameplay. No gameplay, renderer, raster, PMG or collision address changed.

pal_timing_audit.replay_set: default wall-trace set plus --raider-formation-only, --raider-sector-only, --debris-gate-only and --raider-remnant-only; standalone summary over every CSV in build/runtime-wall-trace
